fusions.name: Flypaper Flick
fusions.desc: Whips your tongue at the first enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Swarm the Stalked
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stingers at once, spread apart out to 6 tiles, each dealing 5 damage, rising 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%). Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Honey on Warm Stone
fusions.desc: Spreads a sun-warmed patch of honey 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Cold Blood, Busy Wings
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
